env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

mkdir $WORK/bin

logos build --pedantic -o $WORK/bin/ped$GOEXE .
exists $WORK/bin/ped$GOEXE
exec $WORK/bin/ped$GOEXE
stdout '^hello$'

logos build --pedantic=false .
! stdout 'pedantic'
! stderr 'pedantic'

! logos build --pedantic=maybe .
stderr '^invalid boolean value "maybe" for -pedantic'

logos help build
stdout 'pedantic'

go help build
! stdout 'pedantic'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/pedantic

go 1.27

-- main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("hello")
}
